body:
## Bilingual criterion correction — 2026-10-06 The independent audit found that the original bilingual tick did not cover standalone HTML/native strings. #469 fixes that omission in distribution `ed5a6a51f5974deec8748fbf0dbd2f4984b690f5`, ES `bab4df649f48847cc43d21c77c058107ad902754`, installed candidate15. [Resolution and source-path receipts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/audits/2026_10_06-milestone-m7-p4-fixes-383/08-installed-resolution.md) and [published presentation proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/4a8ab3adaa1a01380f2c3c2896d4e42b373073e3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/p4-presentation-fixes-01) retain145 assertions and29 directly reviewed/hash-bound frames. The actual390px phone confirmation and640px native finishing surfaces pass EN/FR; Keep/Close and the real done callback are verified. Original French-output source control fails as expected; corrected EN/FR output passes. Reconnect proof covers EN/FR640/1280 and EN640 refusal. The local provider Session fixture does not perform a real hosted OAuth exchange. #463 stays optional under D-QA-058. Already written: stored credentials, settings, cloud bytes and callback/done protocol need no migration. This corrects the bilingual evidence, not an RC designation. ## Scope reconciliation — 2026-10-06 D-QA-058/#462 removes Dropbox credentials from release gates now and going forward. All local app/browser criteria below have VM artifacts; the optional authenticated provider-page observation is #463. Closing this issue does not claim that Dropbox authentication or its trust page was tested. ## Retained candidate proof — fallback qualified, 2026-10-05 21:02 UTC Installed replacement10 clean software, actual-upgraded software and virgl sign-in each pass 40 checks and 15 reviewed frames, including actual 390px phone states/margins. Both actual1GiB public-page tests also pass. [Published evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/d7a3edc74741309fa3f008098aa87febe24cfce3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-05-pixelelated-replacement-10). #447 is closed. Authenticated Dropbox trust remains unverified and is optional follow-up #463 under D-QA-058/#462. It does not block this issue or the RC; public/synthetic pages are not substituted for it. Can this be done on the VM? Yes, if later scheduled with dedicated QA access. ## Historical replacement09 candidate proof — 2026-10-05 Exact frozen cf511ce79b/bundle79d560 replacement09: signin-ui11 completes27 checks and six directly reviewed frames on canonical virgl. `phone-metrics.json` records actual390 CSS-pixel Checking/Connected pages, root font16px and top/bottom12px (.75rem) in both. Installed chassis, HTTP302, HTTP Mobile Safari and actual navigator UA checks pass. Finishing uses the declared done-file stand-in and matches the independently reviewed native reference exactly. Four stable-screen receipts and real stale/partial/wrong-size/unsettled controls pass. Durable16:35:21/allfourrc0, actual061ffa cleanup16:35:39. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-05-pixelelated-replacement-09/signin-ui-11/` (published in next `9af943c7ce7966d66bc3a85222013fb2dab16b86`, both remote heads verified16:58:51). Criterion2 is verified. Criterion3 below now covers the locally verifiable handset/Mobile-UA behavior; the authenticated Dropbox observation was split to #463 by the maintainer on 2026-10-06. Public login/OAuth pages are not that page. ## Earlier scoped record Four observations from the maintainer while pairing Dropbox on the Retroid Pocket Nova through the phone keyboard page (2026-09-30), one section each (as #85 did). ## 1. The Close control is where a thumb lands > One issue I just ran into is that the close page right above the pointer makes it easy to accidentally click. […] With the close page, we might want to maybe move this either row below, or, if possible, maybe have it show a modal in style saying "Are you sure?" so someone doesn't accidentally click it like I just did. **Today** (`cloud_oauth` at `224b73ea54`): the Close page key is a `.keys` row of its own at `:992-994`, directly above `

Pointer

` and the drag pad (`:996-997`); it sends Escape, which quits the sign-in window (`:989-991`, `cloud-signin-window.c:499-500`), and a sign-in closed that way is `CLOSED_EARLY` (`:578`): the player starts the sign-in again from the handheld. ## 2. The text above the field is too tight before the keyboard connects > Also, before the keyboard is connected, the text between the keyboard for Dropbox and the text input field is too tightly spaced. **Today**: the state line is `
Checking…
` (`:965`) with no margin of its own, between an `h1` whose bottom margin is `.25rem` (`STYLE`, `:625`) and the input, which has none (`:631`). ## 3. The "Trust this device" picture is tiny > Also, the image we show for "Trust this device" is tiny. I can send a picture if that helps. **Today**: which surface shows it is not yet read; the picture the maintainer offered decides it (Dropbox's own device-approval page in the fullscreen WebKit window, or a page of ours). ## 4. The success screen has no styling > Additionally, the success screen we show doesn't have any styling. We should give it a bit of styling to make it not look a lot like a 404 page or something incredibly basic. **Today**: when the sign-in lands, the window replaces the provider's page with `FINISHING_PAGE`, a one-line `data:` document reading `Finishing up…` in a system font on a dark background with none of the shared style (`cloud-signin-window.c:423-427`); before the done file lands, rclone's own callback page (`127.0.0.1:53682`) may show for a moment. The phone's `Connected` page carries the shared style (`cloud_oauth:738-746`). ## Can this be done on the VM? **Yes** for 1, 2 and 4: guest d's WebKit window plays the phone beside the sign-in window (`proofs-307/phone-page-d.sh`), and headless Firefox renders the page at 390 px on the host. **Partial** for 3: Dropbox's device-approval page appears only on a real Dropbox sign-in; the maintainer's picture is the evidence, and the fix is proven on the VM at the window's size. ## Acceptance criteria - [x] 1: the Close control sits at the bottom of the page, below the note, with at least 2rem of space above it, and a tap asks a confirmation (the safe answer first) before Escape is sent; a 390 px headless-Firefox render shows the placement, and the page's load test (the harness from #330) passes. - [x] 2: the state line has at least `.75rem` above and below it in both states (`Checking…`, `Connected.`); the two 390 px renders show it. - [x] 3: the image ships `CHASSIS=handset` and the installed sign-in window sends Mobile Safari in both actual HTTP requests and `navigator.userAgent`. Replacement10 signin-ui14/15/16 each retain 40 passing checks and 15 reviewed frames; `signin-ui-14/build.log` lines41–47 and `artifacts/signin/all-local-navigator.json` prove this. Replacement14 readback under #462 confirms handset chassis and identical installed `cloud-signin-window`/`cloud_oauth` hashes (`signin-payload-continuity.json`). This reuses explicitly identified prior runtime evidence on unchanged bytes; it is not a new authenticated Dropbox execution. The provider-owned trust-page observation is #463, outside M7. - [x] 4: the finishing page carries the shared `STYLE` (the card, the `h1`, the note), reads as a success, and says what happens next; a frame from guest d's window shows it. - [x] The required close-confirmation controls and native finishing text have EN/FR installed proof under #469/PL-007 (D-UI-051, D-CLOUD-164). The earlier bilingual tick was unsupported for these standalone surfaces; candidate15 repairs them. Broader phone keyboard text remains outside this scoped translation. See the resolution below. ## 3, read from the maintainer's photo (2026-10-01) The screen is **Dropbox's own "Trust this device?" page** rendered in the fork's fullscreen sign-in window (the help bar under it is ours: `A select B back X keyboard Y next L1/R1 scroll SELECT + START to exit`). The tiny image is Dropbox's monitor icon in its desktop layout, which it serves because the window reports a desktop-sized viewport; Dropbox's cookie banner overlaps the bottom left. Nothing in that page is ours to restyle; the lever is the window's: `webkit_web_view_set_zoom_level` keyed on the panel width, or a phone user agent so the provider serves its touch layout. The checkbox above is rewritten to that.
